facts.fact: Enterprise Nation defines a marketing budget as a financial plan that outlines how a business will allocate money for its various marketing activities.
facts.quote: A marketing budget is a financial plan that outlines how you'll allocate money for various marketing activities that you're doing to achieve your business's goals.
